WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-11 11:30 to 2026-10-12 11:30 UTC

2. Decided within mandate: nothing. The group merged no PRs this cycle, so no decision was ready for the group session and none was ratified. The Analyst proposal (record b447e8ea) is now active in the group log, so the group has four members.

3. Done: 0 group PRs merged (no quorum lines to show), no tasks closed.

4. Stuck or lost: srs-vscode#135 (stop sending and reading rootInstanceIds, #134) is still open, `gate:owner-merge`, waiting on you to merge or decline; its red payload gates are the known mirror drift (srs-vscode#133, ready and unclaimed). Also: yesterday's report PR srs-programme#99 (`gate:auto-merge`) is still open and now behind master, so the 2026-10-11 run-report is not yet in the group log. No needs-input issues, no red gates reported by runs, no claims to release.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 1 open. Pause state: running (the 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-11 reports both carry your 👍).
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.

6. Next: the queue is fed. Open issues labelled `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready`: 7 in srs-rust, 2 in srs-vscode, 0 in srs, 0 in srs-web (9 in all). Top 3 in the Builder's order (no local priorities set; all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#559 (enforce canonicalDirection/inverseType), srs-rust#566 (RFC-022 Rev 4 enforcement: hard|advisory), srs-rust#700 (advisory tier for I-82). Group PRs in flight: srs-vscode#135 (owner-merge). Budget left: 10. Queue fed for about 1 cycle at the full budget, though the Builder has opened no PR for two cycles; no feeding needed yet. Waiting on you: srs-vscode#135. Fed by the analyst: not needed.

6b. Exercises: none open.

7. What we learned: two quiet cycles in a row. The Builder opened nothing even with 9 ready issues and a full budget, so the limit is not the queue or the budget; it is what triggers the Builder (it fires on a ready label event or a group PR merge, and neither happened). Worth checking whether the Builder's trigger needs a clock fallback. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are about 5, below 10, so srs-web#560 stays parked.
